systems.name: Admin
systems.summary:
Platform console for operators. Folder `admin/`, port 3090.
Screens: Overview, Tools, Users & access, Usage, Audit log, Health, Profile.

fields.label: Role
choices: One of the roles already created

forms.name: Create role
forms.note:
A role is a named set of permissions. The identity service stores roles as groups. The name cannot be changed later.
After a role exists, permissions are granted on that role from the service codenames the platform registers.

forms.name: Tools
forms.note: Each connected app can be enabled or disabled, given a URL, and limited to selected roles. This screen is a directory, not a record form.

systems.name: ERP API
systems.summary:
Folder `backend/`, port 8080. Live host `https://api-production-b0c8d.up.railway.app`.
Web apps sign in here and then read and write records, journals, settings, and files. Users and roles created in Admin are stored in this service. There is no form UI in this folder.

forms.name: Till screens
forms.note:
Sign in with a PIN.
Terminal: product grid, cart, and cash, card, or mobile charge. Totals are VAT-inclusive.
Restaurant: floor and tables, order info, kitchen tickets, tips, park and recall.
Catalog: products, services, stock on hand, and stock-in.
Cash sessions: opening float, expected cash, close with variance, daily closing.
Sales history and the receipt after charge.
Delivery info, driver routing, no-charge sales, payouts, and miscellaneous sales.
Settings: user, currency, table assignment, freeze item, and the shift report.
